description:
Create, list, print, copy, delete and render notes, each identified by its stem.

Subcommands:
  new --type TYPE --topic TOPIC --thread THREAD [--person NAME] [--counterparty TEXT] [--location TEXT] — create a note and print its path
  list [FILTER] [--json] — list notes, oldest first: stem, date, type, threads, topic
  cat STEM — print a note
  last — print the path of the newest note
  copy STEM — copy a note to a new timestamp; ' COPY' is added to its topic
  delete STEM -y — permanently delete a note
  pdf STEM [--out DIR] — render to markdown and PDF with callouts and an action table; print both paths
  minutes STEM [--out DIR] — render meeting minutes: agreements, resolutions, action items
  agenda STEM [--out DIR] — render a meeting agenda: the note with its outcome sections emptied

Args:
  STEM  the filename without .md, e.g. 2026-09-10-14-30-00; get it from list
  FILTER  case-insensitive text matched against any column

Flags:
  new: --type is required, one of Meeting, Correspondence, Workshop, Report, Log, Research, Recipe. --topic is required and must not be empty. --thread is required and repeatable; give 'Kind/Name' or a wikilink. --person is for Meeting and Correspondence only; repeatable; it becomes a link when people/<name>.md exists. --counterparty and --location are for Meeting only.
  list: --json gives JSON output.
  delete: -y (or --yes) is required.
  pdf, minutes, agenda: --out DIR is the output directory. Default: the user's Downloads directory. Writes <stem>.md and <stem>.md.pdf.

Examples:
  ["new", "--type", "Meeting", "--topic", "Quarterly review", "--thread", "Projects/SGB", "--person", "Charlie"]
  ["list", "sgb", "--json"]
  ["cat", "2026-09-10-14-30-00"]
  ["minutes", "2026-09-10-14-30-00", "--out", "out"]

Notes:
  Every subcommand except new first runs tasks ingest, which rewrites ACTION: lines in notes and logs in place.
  new also queues a REF in the buffer. It reaches the thread's daily log on the next buffer flush.
  delete is permanent.
  pdf, minutes and agenda need pandoc and xelatex.
  Exit 1: bad stem format, no such note, empty topic, --person/--counterparty/--location on the wrong note type, or PDF render failed.

BLOCKED: delete. These subcommands are refused and calling one returns an error. Do not attempt them.
